title: The Mother Who Cried No
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Two mothers came to Solomon,
"This baby's mine!" they cried.
The wise king thought, then called, "A sword!"
To see which one had lied.

[Chorus]
Ask God for wisdom when it's hard,
He'll show you what is true.
And true love wants the best for them,
The way God cares for you.

[Verse 2]
The real mom cried, "No! Don't hurt him!
Just let her have my son!"
Then Solomon knew right away,
Her love showed she's the one.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, you're safe and loved,
Your blanket snug and tight.
Heavenly Father loves like that,
And keeps you through the night.

[Chorus]
mood: Heartbeat music. A slow, steady pulse beats under the voice like a mother's heart against a sleepy cheek, calm through the tense moment of the sword, so the child feels the love that spoke first. The chorus opens warmer and fuller, like arms closing around a returned baby. By the last verse the beat slows and drops lower, until it is only the soft thump of being held.
